description: This file defines the IStateControl interface for managing state transitions (suspend, resume, exit) in a remote object within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes nested notification interface, enums for commands and states, and static methods for string conversion.

classes.name: IStateControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling and monitoring the state of a remote object, including configuration, state querying, request handling, and notification registration.

classes.name: IStateControl::INotification
classes.description: Nested interface for receiving notifications about state changes.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the state control with the provided shell framework.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the object.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Requests a state change command (suspend, resume).

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for state changes.
